name: the extraction context is deep-FROZEN at capture — nothing downstream can mutate what will be committed
it carries every field extraction and commit need — storyId, proposalId, wish, invoker, roster, scene identity, prose, requested scope
a write to the captured wish does not take on the REAL frozen object
...and the nested roster array is frozen too — deep, not one level
a valid, citation-backed extraction COMMITS the durable consequence
...and clears the pending record in the same step (commit and clear are not separable)
...leaving the next continuation UNBLOCKED
a fabricated citation is REJECTED — the quote is not in the accepted prose
a rejected extraction commits NOTHING — no consequence is manufactured
...the pending record survives intact and retryable
...and the continuation is BLOCKED while it is unresolved
the RETRY succeeds and commits, on the same record
the pending record survives a serialise/restore round trip
...and resolves correctly afterwards, committing from the RESTORED context
a response arriving after a STORY SWITCH is refused — the captured storyId decides, not live state
...nothing is written into the story the reader switched TO
...and the OTHER story is not blocked by a record that does not belong to it
returning to the original story finds the record still pending, and it resolves there
writing the same pending key twice yields ONE record, not two
a DUPLICATE completion does not create a second durable consequence
...and the duplicate reports itself as a duplicate rather than a fresh success
a newer wish sealed mid-flight does NOT retarget the commit — it lands under the CAPTURED proposal
...and carries the CAPTURED wish text, not the newer live one
Scene B is BLOCKED while a delivered Tempt scene has an unresolved outcome
...the block names the reason, so it cannot be mistaken for an unrelated failure
Scene B is ALLOWED once the outcome commits
...and the durable consequence Scene B will receive is the extracted one
the bounded resume path resolves everything outstanding for THIS story
a delivered:false extraction manufactures NO consequence and does not silently proceed — it stays pending
the aftermath-cleanup and commit-at-persistence entry points are both still exported
the resolve path NEVER reads live owned-invocation state — the whole point of the immutable context
(a) a GENUINELY MARKED legacy scene migrates — uncited, because it was never asked for citations
(b) UNMARKED old-shaped data is REFUSED — no provenance at all
...refused when provenance names a source but records NO architecture version
...and refused when the recorded version claims to be CURRENT (only a version BELOW the migration counts)
(c) a NEW response carrying a hallucinated self-certified outcome gets NO legacy privilege
...it is REJECTED on the citation check it cannot satisfy, commits nothing, and still requires extraction
(d) legacy adoption is IDEMPOTENT across a reload — one record, not re-armed on re-adoption
...and resolving twice commits exactly once
ZERO real provider dispatches across the whole control
